meta.description: Registry for bounded CSI metric-decay conditions and candidate modes in Phase 3.

csi_metric_decay_entries.name: CSI Metric Decay Structure
csi_metric_decay_entries.purpose: Represent bounded nonlocal metric-decay and transport-weighting behavior across CSI-linked continuation systems.

csi_metric_conditions.name: nonlocal_metric_structure_remains_defined
csi_metric_conditions.description: Formal support for measuring distance across interaction domains in the CSI space.

csi_metric_conditions.name: transport_decay_weighting_remains_bounded
csi_metric_conditions.description: The weighting of transported influence must follow a formal decay law that prevents divergence.

csi_metric_conditions.name: CSI_summation_does_not_force_global_convergence
csi_metric_conditions.description: Summing interaction weights does not imply a globally unique continuation or stable state.

csi_metric_conditions.name: orientation_sensitive_transport_scaling_remains_detectable
csi_metric_conditions.description: Formal mechanisms must exist to track how frame orientation impacts nonlocal transport measure.

csi_metric_conditions.name: recursive_transport_updates_remain_admissible
csi_metric_conditions.description: Each step in the recursive metric update sequence must satisfy current process windows.

csi_metric_conditions.name: finite_transport_flux_preserved_under_metric_decay
csi_metric_conditions.description: Decay weighting must be sufficient to maintain finite flux across nonlocal interactions.

csi_metric_conditions.name: branch_pruning_preserves_required_transport_metric_witness
csi_metric_conditions.description: Pruning must not eliminate all possible paths within required interaction radii.

csi_metric_conditions.name: metric_decay_instability_detectable
csi_metric_conditions.description: Formal mechanisms must exist to detect and register the breakdown of metric scaling or decay closure.
